dct_title_s: Potential affected buildings & impact caused by mudslides in Daraga Municipality, Albay Province, Philippines
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: TC20201111PHL** This map illustrates satellite-detected mudslide extent in the Historical Cagsawa and surrounding in Daraga Municipality, Albay Province, Bicol Region, Philippines as observed on Pleiades image acquired on 13th of November 2020 at 10:47 Local time. About 80 buildings are identified as damaged and 30 as potentially damaged. Some roads were also identified as potentially damaged. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR-UNOSAT.
